name: BreezeMate (Smart Desk Fan)
summary: Monitors ambient desk temperature with a DHT11 sensor and activates a DC cooling fan via relay when ambient heat rises.

bullets: High-contrast 0.96 inch OLED temperature & humidity gauge
Whisper-quiet 5V DC blower fan with isolated relay driver
Snap-fit 3D printable desktop enclosure with translucent acrylic lid

parts.name: Arduino Uno R3
parts.why: Core microcontroller running sensor polling and PWM control

parts.name: 5V 1-Channel Relay Module
parts.why: Switches inductive fan power cleanly without noise

parts.name: 5V DC High-Speed Blower Fan
parts.why: Airflow impeller for active desk cooling

parts.name: 0.96 inch I2C OLED Display
parts.why: Displays live temperature readout and fan RPM state

buildSteps: Step 1: 3D print the snap-fit chassis with 20% infill.
Step 2: Mount the Arduino Uno R3 and secure the standoff clips.
Step 3: Route DHT11, Relay, and OLED I2C wiring according to schematic.
Step 4: Flash firmware and verify temperature threshold trigger.
